title: World's Greatest Business Thinkers — Eric on AI and judgement: 'Outsource the work, not the thinking'
summary: World's Greatest Business Thinkers is Nick Hague's interview podcast, 62 episodes in. Eric argues that entrepreneurs have always been tempted to hand off the hard part of thinking, and that AI makes the temptation cheaper to give in to.
blockquote: As AI makes it easier to generate ideas, analyse problems, and make decisions, there's a risk that entrepreneurs will stop exercising the very judgment they need to build successful businesses.
blockquote_source: World's Greatest Business Thinkers, episode announcement
